name: Sam
description: Skateboards around town and jams in the garage with Sebastian. Loves cactus, pizza, and anything with a good beat.

seo.title: Sam — Musician
seo.description: Skateboards around town and jams in the garage with Sebastian. Loves cactus, pizza, and anything with a good beat.

stardew.intro: Jodi’s eldest, bandmate of Sebastian, and perpetual optimist. Music, skateboarding, and Joja cola fuel most of his days.

heartEvents.title: Skateboard trick
heartEvents.summary: Watch him land a trick in the town square and cheer him on.

heartEvents.title: Band practice
heartEvents.summary: Visit the Sam-Shane-Sebastian garage session behind his house.

heartEvents.title: City audition
heartEvents.summary: He asks you to come to the city for an audition — your support matters.

heartEvents.title: Song for you
heartEvents.summary: He plays a new track he wrote and asks how you feel about him.

heartEvents.title: Boardwalk night
heartEvents.summary: A late walk on the beach ends with him kissing you under the stars.

relationships.name: Sebastian & Abigail
relationships.note: Close friends — arcade nights and band practice are a trio affair.

relationships.name: Penny
relationships.note: Childhood friend; they still look out for each other around town.

trivia: Pizza is loved and buyable from the Saloon once you unlock the recipe — handy for Summer 17 birthdays.
